snippet.title: Drownlight - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512480/Drownlight/
